interval_convention: decimal strings, outward rounding: printed intervals contain the exact rational bisection endpoints

delta.definition: Delta = sigma_0 - 1/2 (zeros of Xi_DH satisfy |Im z| < Delta)

upper_bound_delta_sq_over_2.comparison: exact rational comparison of the outward upper endpoint against 4007/10000

coarse_strip_g2.statement: g(2) < 0 decided on both backends; hence f has no zero in Re s >= 2 and, by the functional equation, F none in Re s <= -1: the in-tree coarse strip -1 < Re s < 2 of zeta/epstein.py

agreement.scout_note: the scout is a 14-decimal rounding; the check is that each decided interval lies inside scout +/- 5e-15 (half an ulp of its last digit)
